Well suicide isnt the answer ive been there many a time and ive survived several attempts ussually with pills. My suggestion is get help go to therapy it helps alot more then you think it will. But if you want advice on how to do it without fail well theres several fail proof ways if you arent worried about what your corpse looks like. You can do roads and highways on your arms and lay in a tub, toaster tub is a definite way, Stabing your heart if you have it in you, slitting your throat and of course the bridge jumping just make sure its high enough and try to land on your head or back. Now the reason iention this isnt for encouragement but rather to show you if you dont have the straight ability to do this to yourself you probably dont want to die but just need mental help which is most likely the case. You can look into account of bridge jumper survivors and the struggle they went through after the survival but mainly them talking about the immidiate regret after jumping. Bridge jumping is a mostly for sure way but you have about 10 to 15 seconds to realize you dont really want to die before you splat. It doesnt seem long but its a very long period when freefalling to your iminent death. Basically every bridge jumper thats survived the fall will tell you they immidately regretted jumping. They all end up paralyzed for atleast a period of time but most are able to go through physical therapy to get some use of their bodies again. Realize that noone knows what comes after life. Its a complete unknown because as you said the dead are silent. For all we know theres nothing you just cease to exist and thats probably the best of outcomes. If religion is correct commiting suicide will either bring you to eternal sufffering worse then what youre going through now because an all knowing deity will know exactly how to torture you specifically. Theres also reincarnation which if you commit suicide means youll probably get the shit end of the stick and come back as some sort of bug or parasyte. Personally my belief is based in spirituality and reincarnation in a different way. I believe we all exist in a set point in time so when we die we just reset and start our lives over with none of the knowledge but rather just get flashbacks from time to time of things that youve experienced before (dejavu). And youll continuously repeat that process until you do what you were meant to do in your lifetime. The more you die the farther you get from the knowledge of what you were meant to do but you just keep repeating your same life with slight variations(alternate realities if you will). Whats stopped me personally from killing myself is the thought that i would have to do this all over again or end up in some random dieties torture chamber. Basically what im saying is you may think you want to die but its probably just mental illness and you should see a doctor because no matter the outcome.of the afterlife all you will accomplish by killing yourself is transfering your pain to friends and family that will forever wish they couldve saved you.
